prompt:
P3 Reload inspired economical graphic anime portrait. One chromatic THEME family + near-black + neutral white. Skin is flat neutral white. Eyes use decisive upper lid and flat iris, nose a minimal shape distinctive to face, mouth a purposeful mark or open graphic silhouette; no lip realism, small texture or detailed ear anatomy. Hands read through overlap and silhouettes, no nails, tendons or knuckles. Hair uses coherent masses and few large locks. Clothing two or three large hard-edged shadow planes. Preserve age, body and face geometry without turning every person into an idealized same-face protagonist.
BACKGROUND: bright MAIN THEME field plus ONE or TWO broad deeper SAME-HUE graphic regions, about 15-30% of background area. Pick sweeping arc, diagonal cut, wide edge band or off-center curve to support the character gesture and negative space. The deeper region must still visibly read as the theme hue, NEVER near-black. No gradient, glow, grain, texture, tiny pattern, text, logo, typography, particles or transparency. Not a completely single-value solid background. Not the same exact arc placement in every image. The background is fully opaque to all four image edges.
Square source for circular avatar. Eyes, nose, mouth, chin and dominant hair silhouette inside centered circle. Head height roughly 50-65% of canvas; no full body, no distant tiny head, no drawn circle border. Vary head and shoulders, expressive gestures and camera in the safe circle. No routine white forelock or eye-corner beauty mark. Color does not count as a different identity. Render the requested actual facial structure, expression and posture clearly, not merely different labels.

INDIVIDUAL: 21-year-old androgynously presented person, ordinary neck and average shoulders. FACIAL GEOMETRY: short round face with full cheeks and a short rounded chin; small wide-set heavy-lidded eyes, thick low horizontal eyebrows, a short wide nose contour, a wide thin mouth. Keep facial proportions distinctly recognizable through silhouette and few marks. 
HAIR SILHOUETTE: one near-black mass, smooth severe side part and tapered nape. Do not add white forelock except an entirely white hairstyle if explicitly requested. No glasses.
FACIAL EXPRESSION: delight: eyes squeezed pleasantly, high cheeks; mouth wider with one simple white tooth band, strong corners appropriate to emotion. Mouth/eyes/brows visibly differ from a generic polite smile.
GESTURE: one hand adjusting a broad scarf across chest; head upright and gaze direct. CAMERA: front, high-angle; both eyes similar size, nose centered, near symmetrical frontal head. The camera orientation takes priority if a gesture description conflicts. Adapt pose into head-and-upper-chest crop, never full figure.
WARDROBE: utility work vest, high close collar framing neck. One broad readable garment silhouette, no little details.
PALETTE: main #16B994; deeper #147D66; near-black #09121B; neutral white #FAFBFC. No colors outside this family. BACKGROUND: bright main #16B994 plus offset circular arc behind shoulder in deeper #147D66, approximately 20% of background, no black background and not completely flat single-value background.
Make this one ORIGINAL standalone character distinct from previously generated portraits in face, expression, silhouette and clothing. Do not copy an existing character or use a stock handsome anime face. One clean finished square portrait.
FINAL COMPOSITION CHECK: Keep eyes as a single lid and flat shape; no shiny rendered iris, no long individual lashes. Keep ear just an outer contour and one shadow. Prefer fewer larger hair locks, do not hatch shaved hair. EXACT FRONTAL FACE: nose and philtrum on vertical center line, both ears visible equally, both eyes equal size. Artistry comes from shoulder diagonal and head roll, never a three-quarter yaw. Camera visibly ABOVE the forehead looking down, crown visible, chin overlaps neck.
